_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); net revenue, client assets, expense, trading activity and pre-tax margin signals with Schwab's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'The Charles Schwab Corporation (CSC) ... engages, through its subsidiaries (collectively referred to as Schwab or the Company), in wealth management, securities brokerage, banking, asset management, custody, and financial advisory services.' 'Developments in the business, economic, and geopolitical environment could negatively impact our business.' 'Our industry is highly competitive and characterized by aggressive price competition.' (FY2024 10-K); DURABLE, risk 2: the 10-K ties results to markets, rates and investor engagement and names price competition, a cycle and a competitive field, and does not call its own business cyclical (the JPM, LOW and SHW reading); no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json has dated evidence for a securities broker and bank on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining', EV to 'battery-electric vehicles displace ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail', CRYPTO to 'crypto / DeFi disintermediates payments networks, banks, exchanges, remittance', GENAI to 'generative / autonomous AI substitutes the core product: software seats, IT services and BPO hours, professional information, search, education content, mobility', GLP1 to 'GLP-1 obesity drugs reduce demand for snacks, beverages, sleep-apnea/diabetes/cardio devices': CRYPTO alone names banks and exchanges, and no 10-K names cryptocurrency, blockchain, digital assets or a distributed ledger, so nothing dated ties it to Schwab; of the rest none names brokerage or banking, and no 10-K names offshore delivery, e-commerce, streaming, decarbonisation, electric vehicles or GLP-1 drugs, and the FY2024 10-K names cloud technologies only as a service its own systems rely on ('Cloud technologies are critical to the operation of our systems and platforms and our reliance on cloud technologies is growing.'), not as a way its own business is delivered or displaced, and the FY2024 10-K names artificial intelligence only as a tool of external fraud and cyber attack ('Information security risks for financial institutions are increasing, in part because of the use of the internet and mobile and cloud technologies to conduct financial transactions, and the increased sophistication and activities, including the use of artificial intelligence technologies, of organized crime, activists, hackers and other external parties, including foreign state actors.'), not as a substitute for its own services), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS -27.4%/yr (worst year FY15-FY24, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +21.3%/yr (Q2 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +21.3%/yr (FY15-FY24 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +36.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY15-FY24, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: SCHW (retrospective, 2025-08-08) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 4.44x (73.2% downside to Bear $26.06 / +16.5% upside to Bull $113.08) | Adj composite 2.65 vs market 3.24: gap -0.59 [OVERVALUED] | +80% above the EPP floor $53.82 (18x FY25E $2.99) | Conservative 2-yr case: -1.3% total (-0.7%/yr) | At 32.5x FY25E the 15% hurdle price $128.39 sits above the BULL case; revenue +24.8% YoY in Q2 2025, forward revenues +24.8% (Q2 2025 revenue growth (no Q3 2025 guide)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
